units.title: Introduction
units.topics: International Economics: Meaning, Scope and Importance, Inter-regional and International Trade, International Trade & Economic Growth, Gains from international trade.

units.title: International Trade Theory
units.topics: Classical theories: Adam Smith and David Ricardo, Modern Theory: Heckscher-Ohlin Theory, Leontief's Paradox, Stolper-Samuelson Theory of Tariff, Intra-Industry Trade.

units.title: Trade Policy
units.topics: Gains from Trade, Terms of Trade: Meaning, Types and Determinants, Causes of Unfavourable Terms of Trade for Developing Countries, Measures to correct Unfavourable Terms of Trade, Balance of Trade and Balance of Payments concepts, components, disequilibrium causes, consequences and corrective measures.

units.title: International Trade Agreements & Regional Integration
units.topics: Free Trade vs. Protection, Tariffs and Non-Tariff Barriers (Quotas, Subsidies, Voluntary Export Restraints), Regional Economic Integration: EU, ASEAN, SAARC, WTO: Agreements, TRIPS, TRIMS, and developing economies.

units.title: Introduction to Public Finance
units.topics: Origin of Public Finance, Meaning, Nature & Scope, Private Finance vs. Public Finance, Importance and Role, Principle of Maximum Social Advantage (Dalton, Musgrave).

units.title: Public Expenditure
units.topics: Meaning and Principles of Public Expenditure, Trends in Public Expenditure since 2011 in India, Causes of Growth of Public Expenditure, Effects of Public Expenditure, Theories: Wagner's Law, Peacock-Wiseman Hypothesis, Social Cost and Benefit Analysis.

units.title: Public Revenue
units.topics: Meaning and Needs of Public Revenue, Sources of Public Revenue, Internal and External Public Debt, Classification and Principles of Public Revenue, Effects and Significance.

units.title: Taxation
units.topics: Meaning and Characteristics of Tax, Canons of Taxation (Adam Smith), Direct and Indirect Taxes, Impact, Incidence and Shifting of Tax, Taxable Capacity, Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India.

units.title: India's Balance of Payments
units.topics: Structure of Balance of Payments, Components, Current and Capital Account, Trends in India's Balance of Payments, Nature of India's Trade Balance.

units.title: Direction of India's Foreign Trade
units.topics: India's Trade with the world, Exports Trend, Imports Trend, Region-wise Import and Export, Import Substitution and Export Promotion Measures in India.

units.title: Foreign Capital and Economics Development
units.topics: Foreign Capital: Concept, Types, Merits and Demerits, FDI & FII in India, Foreign Debt, Role of IMF, World Bank, and Asian Development Bank in India's Economic Development.

units.title: Budget
units.topics: Meaning, Revenue and Capital Budget, Surplus, Deficit and Balanced Budget, Preparation of Indian Central Budget, Deficit concepts (Revenue, Fiscal, Primary Deficit), Gender Budgeting, Zero Base Budgeting.

units.title: Taxation
units.topics: Meaning and Characteristics of Tax, Impact, Incidence and Shifting of Tax, Indian Tax Structure, Features & Defects of Indian Tax System, GST evolution, merits and demerits.

units.title: Fiscal Policy
units.topics: Meaning and Objectives of Fiscal Policy, Instruments and Limitations of Fiscal Policy, Trends in Public Debt since 2011 in India, Case studies and practical assignments.

units.title: Banking System
units.topics: Evolution and Structure of Banking System in India, Commercial Banks: Functions, Credit Creation, Reserve Bank of India (RBI): Monetary Policy and Regulatory Framework.

units.title: Banking in India
units.topics: Banking Sector Reforms (Narasimham Committee I & II), Non-Performing Assets (NPAs): Causes and Resolution, Small Finance Banks, Payment Banks, Cooperative Banking in India.

units.title: Bank Accounts and Operations
units.topics: Practical aspects of opening and operating bank accounts, KYC norms, Negotiable instruments, Cheque clearing, CTS system.

units.title: Bank Loans and Payment Systems
units.topics: Types of loans and advances, Loan appraisal process, CIBIL score, Modern payment systems: NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, Micro-finance and SHG lending.

units.title: Digital Banking and Financial Inclusion
units.topics: Internet and Mobile Banking, Cyber safety in banking, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY), Banking Ombudsman Scheme.

units.title: Measures of Central Tendency
units.topics: Concept and importance of central tendency, Mean, Median, Mode, Geometric Mean, Harmonic Mean for grouped and ungrouped data, Properties and applications.

units.title: Measures of Dispersion
units.topics: Concept of dispersion, Range, Quartile Deviation, Mean Deviation, Standard Deviation, Variance, Coefficient of Variation, Skewness and Kurtosis concepts.

units.title: Correlation
units.topics: Scatter diagram, Karl Pearson's coefficient of correlation, Spearman's rank correlation coefficient, computation and economic interpretation.

units.title: Probability and Distributions
units.topics: Basic probability concepts, Addition and multiplication rules, Binomial, Poisson and Normal distributions and their economic applications.

units.title: Measures of Central Tendency and Dispersion Applications
units.topics: Practical computation of central tendency and dispersion measures using economic data, software-based computations and graphical representations.

units.title: Introduction to Agricultural Economics
units.topics: Nature and scope of agricultural economics, Role of agriculture in economic development, Land reforms, Farm size and productivity relationship in India.

units.title: Agricultural Production and Marketing
units.topics: Agricultural inputs and technologies, Green Revolution, Agricultural marketing channels, Regulated markets, e-NAM, Minimum Support Price (MSP) policy.

units.title: Field survey
units.topics: Methods of field survey, Field visits, Pilot survey, Observation, Sampling techniques, Designing questionnaire and schedule.

units.title: Report writing
units.topics: Literature review, Methods of presentation (Classification, Tabulation, Graphs), Interpretation of field data, Report writing and submission.

units.title: Digital Economy: Definition and Framework
units.topics: Concept, definition and characteristics of digital economy, India Stack, Digital Public Infrastructure, Impact of digitalization on growth and employment.

units.title: Digital Economy in Different Sectors
units.topics: E-Commerce and platform economy, Digital finance and FinTech, Digital governance and public service delivery, Challenges of digital divide and data security.

units.title: Foundations and Classical Political Economy
units.topics: Nature, Scope and Significance of History of Economic Thought, Mercantilism and Physiocracy, Classical Economics: Adam Smith, David Ricardo, Malthus, J.S. Mill, Marxist and Socialist Thought: Karl Marx and Engels.

units.title: Marginal Revolution and Keynesian Transformation
units.topics: The Marginal Revolution: Jevons, Menger, Walras, Neoclassical Economics: Marshall, Clark, Fisher, The Keynesian Revolution: Great Depression, Keynesian Theory and Policy, Post-Keynesian Developments.

units.title: Contemporary Developments and Emerging Schools
units.topics: Monetarism (Milton Friedman), Austrian School, Behavioral Economics (Kahneman, Tversky), Institutional Economics, Nobel Laureates in Economics.

units.title: Indian Economic Thought
units.topics: Kautilya's Arthashastra, Dadabhai Naoroji (Drain Theory), Mahadev Govind Ranade, Mahatma Gandhi, Dr. B. R. Ambedkar, Amartya Sen.

units.title: Economic Growth and Development
units.topics: Economic Growth: Meaning and Indicators, Economic Development: Meaning and Indicators, Obstacles to Development in LDCs, Growth, Poverty and Income Inequality.

units.title: Theories of Economic Growth
units.topics: Classical Approach: Adam Smith, Marx, Schumpeter, Neo-Classical Growth Models: Harrod-Domar, Solow, Rostow's Stages of Growth, Hirschman's Unbalanced Growth.

units.title: Theories of Economic Development
units.topics: Big Push Theory (Rosenstein-Rodan), Nurkse's Vicious Circle of Poverty, Leibenstein's Critical Minimum Effort, Arthur Lewis Model of Unlimited Labour, Endogenous Growth Theory.

units.title: Human Capital and Economic Development
units.topics: Role of Education and Health in Development, Human Development Index (HDI), Gender Inequality Index (GII), Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI), Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

units.title: Measuring Economic Growth and Structural Change
units.topics: Computation of GDP growth rate, Sectoral composition of national income, Structural transformation in India.

units.title: Poverty, Unemployment and Inequality
units.topics: Measurement of poverty line, Headcount ratio, Lorenz curve, Gini coefficient, Unemployment rates computation and analysis.

units.title: Measuring Human Development
units.topics: Calculating Human Development Index (HDI), Multi-dimensional Poverty Index (MPI), Interstate comparisons of human development indicators in India.

units.title: Basics of Computer for Economics
units.topics: Computer hardware, operating systems, spreadsheets (MS Excel), Data entry, formatting, formula implementation for economic calculations.

units.title: Data Sources and Handling
units.topics: Accessing economic databases (RBI, MoSPI, World Bank, IMF, CMIE), Data cleaning, filtering, sorting, pivot tables in Excel.

units.title: Introduction to Statistical Software
units.topics: Statistical data analysis using Excel / SPSS / R, Descriptive statistics, correlation, regression analysis, plotting economic trends.

units.title: Introduction
units.topics: Meaning, nature and scope of industrial economics, Classification of industries, Industrial efficiency, Theories of industrial location (Weber, Sargent Florence).

units.title: Indian Industrial Growth, Policy and Location
units.topics: Trends in industrial production (IIP) in India, New Industrial Policy 1991, Disinvestment policy, MSMEs: Role and challenges, Special Economic Zones (SEZs).

units.title: Introduction to Industrial Economics
units.topics: Practical analysis of firm behaviour, Market structure measurement, Concentration ratios (CR4, Herfindahl-Hirschman Index).

units.title: Industrial Location and Concentration
units.topics: Analyzing location factors of specific industries in Maharashtra, agglomeration economies, industrial cluster study.

units.title: Industrial Growth in India
units.topics: Analysis of Index of Industrial Production (IIP), Performance of key manufacturing sectors, Industrial sickness case studies.

units.title: Sampling & Distribution
units.topics: Sampling techniques: Random and non-random sampling, Sampling distribution, Standard error, Central Limit Theorem.

units.title: Estimating Population Parameters and Hypothesis Testing
units.topics: Point and interval estimation, Confidence intervals, Hypothesis testing procedure, Null and alternative hypothesis, Type I and Type II errors, Large sample Z-test, Small sample t-test, Chi-square test, F-test.

units.title: Hypothesis Testing
units.topics: Practical application of Z-test, two-sample t-test, paired t-test, Chi-square test for independence of attributes using economic datasets.

units.title: Index Number
units.topics: Construction of Laspeyres, Paasche, Fisher's Price and Quantity Index Numbers, Consumer Price Index (CPI), WPI calculation.

units.title: Regression
units.topics: Simple and multiple linear regression analysis, Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) estimation, interpreting regression output and ANOVA.

units.title: Agriculture Production
units.topics: Practical analysis of crop productivity, Cost of cultivation concepts (Cost A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2), Farm budgeting exercises.

units.title: Agriculture Marketing
units.topics: Field study of APMC mandi, Market margins and price spread, Price volatility analysis of key agricultural commodities.

units.title: Agriculture Business and Finance
units.topics: Assessment of Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme, Agricultural credit appraisal, Performance evaluation of Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs).
